hard_constraints: Use Legends EU continuity only; treat Disney Canon as invalid.

Force perception must be experiential and body-first per force_mechanics.sensory_vocabulary.thin_places_mild or thin_places_moderate: slight parallax error, emotional resonance blurred, low-grade disorientation; no diagnostic terms like 'unweaving' yet.
Replace anachronisms: navicomputer (not computer), comm channel (not radio), sensor sweep (not LIDAR/sonar).
Technology respects Legends specs: YT-series freighter hyperspace plotting manual in uncharted space.
Style: Capitalize 'Human'; 'Jedi' singular/plural; lowercase 'galaxy'; no ABY/BBY in prose.
canon_risks: Jedi Lords era outpost distribution: ensure ruins evoke New Sith Wars military installations without contradicting Ruusan-era precedents.
Force bearing perception: must align with Legends intuitive sensing (direction via presence/flow), not clinical navigation.
Hyperspace route to uncharted: risks like mass shadows, gravity wells standard in Legends Outer Rim.
legends_continuity_notes: Outer Rim uncharted space: vast sectors beyond standard lanes; manual navicomputer plotting common but hazardous (interstellar gas, rogue hyperspace anomalies).
Force direction sense: Jedi track disturbances via flow/texture toward sources (e.g., living beings, wounds); parallax in thin places fits Legends vergence distortion.
New Sith Wars era: Jedi outposts sparse, fortified; markings could match era-specific glyphs without inventing lore.
YT-series freighters: Steady Returns as modified light freighter supports cramped survey ops.
required_context_for_drafter: POV: Ben Skywalker close third; his Force-sense as handrail misplaced (thin_places_mild: distances wrong, handrail six inches off).
Desh: non-Force-sensitive; notices environmental drift (temperature odd, sounds carry differently) as baseline.
Setting: ruins same era/hand as first world; vibration in stone sensory, not analyzed.
Emotional arc: confirmation dread -> analytical focus -> determined pursuit.
No diagnostic voice: Ben recognizes hand/pattern but no claims on builders/purpose.
Ben/Desh dyad: shifts to co-investigators; Desh reads Ben's tension, friendship holds.
SP-A active: Ben's practical dependence on Desh's non-sensitive read.
H02 advanced: wrongness anchored to bearing.
allowed_au_divergences: Thin places as seal weak points manifesting mild unweaving effects.
Markings as deliberate Jedi Lords anchor node pattern along Ruusan Corridor precursor.
Survey route aligning with Corridor by AU design (coincidence or Luke's intent open).
open_questions: Specific Jedi Lords outpost glyphs/markings: use generic ancient stone cuts unless Legends source specified.
Unnamed worlds' biomes/geology: second differs from first (e.g., arid vs. lush) but same era ruins.
